channel.title: Long Island Business News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Island Business News (libn.com)

item.title: Tariffs linger over earnings, even as companies get used to them
item.description: Many U.S. companies have sought to reassure investors that tariffs are "manageable," but early earnings-season comments suggest profit margins are at risk

item.title: ColorPop Workshop expands with second Long Island studio
item.description: ColorPop Workshop is opening a Westhampton Beach art studio for kids ages 2–12, offering guided art projects, workshops, camps and parties.

item.title: Strong Pilates Commack opens 4,000-square-foot studio
item.description: Strong Pilates Commack opens a 4,000-square-foot studio on Jericho Turnpike, offering low-impact cardio, strength and Pilates workouts on Long Island

item.title: Industrial property on Sunrise Highway sells for $2.85M
item.description: An industrial property on Sunrise Highway sold for $2.85 million and will be redeveloped as an auto parts warehouse by a Long Island buyer.

item.title: Cold winter, pending budget cuts raise concerns for LI homelessness
item.description: Northwell Health and the Long Island Coalition for the Homeless warn homelessness may rise amid federal budget cuts.

item.title: Melville mixed-use property trades for $1.125M
item.description: A mixed-use property on Walt Whitman Road in Melville sold for $1.125 million, featuring ground-floor retail and second-floor office space.

item.title: Northwell opens psychedelic research center for mental health
item.description: Northwell Health launches Center for Psychedelics Research and Treatment to explore psilocybin, MDMA, ketamine, and cannabis for mental health treatment

item.title: Broxmeyer affiliates to buy Valley Stream apartments for $33.375M
item.description: Affiliates of Gary Broxmeyer are acquiring two Valley Stream apartment buildings for $33.375M.

item.title: Former LI tax preparer pleads guilty to $12M fraud scheme
item.description: A former Long Island tax preparer pleads guilty to $12M tax and PPP fraud, facing years in prison and millions in restitution.

item.title: Texas Rangers sports firm acquires Long Island Ducks
item.description: REV Entertainment, the Texas Rangers’ sports arm, has acquired the Long Island Ducks, the Atlantic League’s winningest and most attended team.
